contact_method: Evaluate actual world-space parent-frame triangles; find their nearest surface point to child pivot, then require that point inside every outward half-space of the actual closed convex gimbal. Also compare gimbal centre and transformed parent attachment landmark to the child pivot. A nonpositive signed facet violation establishes an occupied frame junction, not armour clearance.
